idea-plugin.name: A-Complete
idea-plugin.description:
A-Complete — Fast, Minimalist AI Code Completion

Write code at lightning speed with AI assistance directly in your editor. Press Ctrl+Alt+\ on any comment or prompt line, and the generated code is inserted right below within ~1.5 seconds.

Features

  • Instant generation: Trigger AI code completion directly at caret or on selected prompt comments.
  • OpenRouter & OpenAI compatible: Works with any model available on OpenRouter (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, DeepSeek V3/R1, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Llama 3.3, Qwen 2.5 Coder) or any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
  • OS Keychain security: Sensitive API keys are securely stored in the OS Credential Store (PasswordSafe) instead of plaintext files.
  • Non-intrusive UX: Error reports use IDE balloon notifications with one-click settings navigation instead of polluting your source code.
  • Context-aware: Automatically detects surrounding code, file type, and prompt indentation for clean integration.
  • Connection tester: Built-in latency & connection verification tool in Settings → Tools → A-Complete.

action.description: Generate code from comment or prompt using AI
